newsitem.title: UK: UK sporting events sponsored by tobacco firms. [corrected 18:05 gmt]
newsitem.headline: UK sporting events sponsored by tobacco firms. [corrected 18:05 gmt]

text.p: Britain's new Labour government on Monday banned sponsorship of sporting events by tobacco companies, dealing a blow to many of the nation's favourite fixtures.
The following UK sporting events are sponsored by tobacco firms.
Cricket -- Benson and Hedges owned by Gallaher, a subsidiary of American Brands Inc, The Benson and Hedges Cup.
Golf -- Benson and Hedges International Open, Rugby League Silk Cut Challenge Cup and Regal Trophy. Silk Cut is also owned by Gallaher.
(Corrects by deleting refernece to Alfred Dunhill Cup as Alfred Dunhill is no longer a tobacco brand as part of luxury products maker Vendome Luxury Group Plc).

Snooker -- the Embassy World Championships, (The Embassy brand is owned by Imperial Tobacco ) Benson and Hedges Championship, Benson and Hedges Masters, Regal Welsh Open, Regal Scottish Masters, Embassy World Pool Championships.
Darts -- World championships sponsored by Embassy Angling -- Benson and Hedges International, Embassy Challenge.
Ice Hockey -- Benson and Hedges Cup.
British-based Formula one motor racing teams with major cigarette sponsorships include Williams - Rothmans, Benetton - Mild Seven, Jordan - Benson and Hedges, Tyrell - Mild Seven, McLaren - West.
